description: Debian (bookworm) -dev packages needed to compile an extension against each library the baseline names (build/extensions.json, an extension's 'libs' and 'withLibs'). Only build-time packages: the runtime libraries an image keeps are found from what the built extensions link (ldd), as the official PHP images do. A library missing here is one the extension builds itself or that the base image already carries.

loadAfter.description: Extensions that link against another extension and so must be loaded after it. docker-php-ext-enable names an ini file after its extension and PHP reads conf.d in name order, so event (docker-php-ext-event.ini) would load before sockets and fail with an undefined symbol: socket_ce. Each extension listed here is enabled under an ini name that sorts after every docker-php-ext-*.ini.

odbcDrivers.description: ODBC drivers the standard and full images carry, so odbc/pdo_odbc reach the common databases without another layer: PostgreSQL, MariaDB/MySQL, SQLite, and FreeTDS for Microsoft SQL Server and Sybase.
